name: ArenaAreaRegion - Default (seed v1)
description: One WorldGuard region of an arena area (arena duels rev. 6). Opened from the area's Regions step, with the area already filled in.

steps.description: Draw the region in game. It is renamed arena_<arena id>_<kind>_<id> when saved; the game server gives it its parent (the arena's region), priority and flags (pvp allow on battlegrounds, entry allow everywhere: the duel runtime decides who may cross).

fields.label: Area
fields.description: The area this region belongs to. A region can't move to another area: remove it and add it there.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Use Send to Minecraft and select the part with WorldEdit (//sel cuboid, //sel poly, or //sel cyl for a round part), or type 'select <region>' in game to adopt an existing region such as a v1 arena_2,<part>-battleground (it is renamed too). Must be in the arena's world and used by no domain or other area.
